programs.title: NHL Hockey
programs.desc: The Avalanche and Wild open their Western Conference second-round series. The Presidents' Trophy-winning Avalanche enter after a first-round sweep, while the Wild advanced in six. Nathan MacKinnon had seven points versus the Wild this year.

programs.title: NHL Hockey
programs.desc: The West second-round Game 2 gets underway as the Wild take on the Avalanche at Ball Arena. Colorado leads the series after a 9-6 win. Cale Makar scored twice and Devon Toews had a goal and three assists, while Nathan MacKinnon also netted a goal.

programs.title: NHL Hockey
programs.desc: The Avalanche face the Wild in Game 3 of the West second round at Grand Casino Arena in St. Paul. Colorado has won two straight. Martin Necas scored in Game 2, but Kirill Kaprizov tied it six seconds later for the fifth-fastest response in history.

programs.title: NHL Hockey
programs.desc: Colorado clashes Minnesota in Game 4 of the West Second Round with the Avalanche leading the series 2-1. Minnesota secured a 5-1 Game 3 victory as the Western Conference Central Division rivals play the fourth series matchup at Grand Casino Arena.

programs.title: NHL Hockey
programs.desc: The Avalanche host the Wild at Ball Arena for a pivotal Game 5 matchup. Following a recent 5-2 victory, Colorado leads this series 3-1. Minnesota looks to Kirill Kaprizov to avoid elimination and counter a Colorado offense led by Nathan MacKinnon.
